description.player_sees: A ~€0.008 plastic gold kids' sheriff badge, stamped 'SUMMER VACATION TRIVIA CHAMP 2003' in flaking glitter print, from the same defective 2003 merch pallet as the stein and Hamagotchi.
description.bros_see: This is basically a Mensa card, bro. Like, a WEARABLE one. This star means something.

effects.special_effect: Permanently pinned to the winning bro's chest, cannot be removed, hidden, unequipped, or given to another bro. Lands visibly crooked and stays crooked.

accumulation.note: permanent character-sprite overlay, not a hostel-displayed item

items.delivery_location: prize_podium (on-site, Fauxst Beach, handed over by Jaxson Vane immediately after the badge is pinned)

description.player_sees: A hollow, yellowed plastic beer stein from the same defective 2003 merch pallet as the badge. The seam was never sealed; anything poured in seeps back out along a constant drip line.
description.bros_see: This isn't a cup, bro, this is a TROPHY you can DRINK OUT OF.

effects.special_effect: Active ability 'Take a Swig': 60-second cooldown, restores +5 HP, 20% chance to trigger Glitter Gullet (-1 Speed, 10 seconds, no cure item needed).

items.delivery_location: hostel door (OFF-SITE, not at the Bohemian Riviera) — handed over by an unnamed Shady Productions runner who does not make eye contact and does not stop moving; Petra supervises and logs the handoff but never touches the item

description.player_sees: A knockoff, waterlogged Tamagotchi branded with a crude decal of Hamstradamus's face. Buttons corroded solid; the screen has been stuck for over two decades on a single flickering hamster-ghost frame.
description.bros_see: Bro, this is VINTAGE tech. This basically makes me a collector now.

effects.special_effect: Permanently Treasured (cannot be discarded, sold, or traded). Screen Never Changes.

items.note: Awarded off-site. The Bohemian Riviera location data marks this as a quest reward whose physical hand-off is staged at the hostel door, not at Fauxst Beach — no Bohemian Riviera NPC hands it over in person.

description.player_sees: A bucket-sized piña colada in an imported plastic coconut shell painted to look tropical. Kokos Loco's signature landlocked-beach cocktail.
description.bros_see: This is basically what they drink in actual Hawaii, bro.

effects.note: liquid_confidence: +3 Charm, +2 Bravado, -1 Accuracy, 3-5 turns. sloppy: -3 Accuracy, 15% chance to hit allies, 1-2 turns. Cheap beach-bar cocktail bucket stacking both effects.

description.player_sees: A shot glowing the exact color of the tanning-bed neon wallpapered across The Tan Line's walls. Nobody behind the bar will confirm what's actually in it.
description.bros_see: This is definitely gonna make me look tan from the inside, bro.

effects.note: sloppy: -3 Accuracy, 15% chance to hit allies, 1-2 turns.

shop_economics.currency_accepted: gold (bar-strip pricing table also references euros/koruna in the location profile's economic integration section)
